body.solutionSummary:
Aetheris is an AI-driven learning platform that converts static academic content into interactive, narrative-based learning experiences.

Narrative Engine: Transforms syllabus content into story-driven formats based on user-selected themes (e.g., sci-fi, fantasy), improving engagement and memory retention.
Adaptive Learning Graph: Replaces fixed chapter progression with a dynamic system that adjusts learning paths based on user performance.
Interactive Assessments (“Shadow Duels”): Instead of traditional quizzes, learners solve scenario-based challenges that test real-world application of concepts.
Narrative-Based Learning: Combines storytelling with education to improve engagement and recall
Adaptive Remediation: Automatically identifies weak areas and generates targeted learning modules
Skill-Based Evaluation: Focuses on application-driven assessments rather than rote memorization
